w: They call it the Castle of Light — a landmark designed in 1989 by Gunnar Birkerts, a Latvian architect who'd emigrated to America and built his career there. The library itself dates to 1919, founded under Jānis Misiņš, who established Latvian scientific bibliography; the building didn't open until 2014, a quarter-century after it was drawn.
s: Latvia's library, the Castle of Light
_facts: Known as the Castle of Light (Gaismas pils)
Formed in 1919 after Latvian independence; first supervisor was Jānis Misiņš
Current building designed in 1989 by Latvian-American architect Gunnar Birkerts
